_: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored — the token in
it is the only thing standing between the internet and Ric's match log.
The token is the one set on the Worker:
cd ../server && npx wrangler@latest secret put APEX_TOKEN
_monitor: Which display Apex is on. 0 is primary. dxcam counts from 0.
_mode: What the watcher assumes it is watching when the screen does not say.
'br' or 'ranked' — it changes nothing about the read, only how the page
groups the match. Ranked also makes the win-too-short check apply.
_keep_frames: Keep a JPEG of every frame a match was read from, in watcher/frames/.
They never leave the machine and are never uploaded — this is so a number
that looks wrong on the page can be checked against the pixels that made
it. About 200KB a match; a heavy night is 5MB. Worth it while the OCR is
